checks.name: Opaque-origin readiness, initial state, exact ASCII shape
All deterministic presets, 256 cells and repeat pixels
Both axes, no-op stamp, one-step Undo/Redo, erase with None
Sparse pointer interpolation and single undo
Pointer exit clamps and keeps completed marks
Active stroke is finalized before settings action
Keyboard clamp, Home/End, Space/Enter, focus and inputs
Reject empty, 0, 17 and fractional coordinates without history
No-op clear/preset/stamp history and redo invalidation
Double invert identity, palette ASCII invariance, metrics
Reset restores all settings and empties history
Copy success, fallback success, denial and full selection
Responsive widths and 200% root text: no page overflow, square canvases
No external requests or script errors

repairs: Test harness scrolls editor into view before coordinate-based pointer interactions; first run clicked outside the scrolled viewport.
limitations: Independent agent reproduction, not independent human-user coverage.
Clipboard success and denial simulated because opaque-origin clipboard access is browser-policy dependent.
Touch exercised through Chromium CDP emulation; no physical touchscreen.
independence: Read only provided pack as product specification; no original demo/repository inspection or edits.
